body:
### Summary

This PR moves the mapping between `ClimaParams.jl` parameter names and `CloudMicrophysics.jl` parameter structs/options into one file. Thanks to this we can auto-generate parameter documentation. The PR also adds checks that all 1-moment and non-equilibrium process functions have correct parameters that match the chosen options.

1. **Centralized `ClimaParams` Name Maps**:
   - Defines [`name_map(T)`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/parameters/name_maps.jl#L16-L26) for every parameter struct and 1-moment process option, and [`make_params(td, nm)`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/parameters/name_maps.jl#L28-L39) to read and tag parameters from `ClimaParams.ParamDict` (automatically converting `Vector` entries to `Tuple`s for GPU compatibility).
   - Generates `ParamDict` constructors directly from `name_map(T)` for all plain parameter structs ([`PLAIN_PARAMETER_TYPES`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/parameters/name_maps.jl#L636-L690), now including `Chen2022VelTypeSmallIce`, `Chen2022VelTypeLargeIce`, and `Chen2022VelTypeRain`) and `NamedTuple`-backed 1-moment process options ([`NAMEDTUPLE_OPTION_TYPES`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/parameters/name_maps.jl#L695-L710)).
   - Tests in [test/parameter_name_maps_tests.jl](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/test/parameter_name_maps_tests.jl) verify that every `name_map` matches the exact set of `ClimaParams` parameters read by its constructor.

2. **Compile-Time Option / Parameter Consistency Check**:
   - Adds `CMP.process_params(mp, opt)`, which derives both the `mp.process_params` slot ([`process_field(opt)`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/parameters/name_maps.jl#L714-L725)) and the expected parameter struct or `NamedTuple` field set ([`expected_process_params(typeof(opt))`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/parameters/name_maps.jl#L728-L746)) directly from `opt` and `name_map`.
   - Replaces ad-hoc `_consistent_params` helpers in [src/Microphysics1M.jl](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/Microphysics1M.jl) and guards all option-dispatched process functions in [src/Microphysics1M.jl](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/Microphysics1M.jl) and [src/MicrophysicsNonEq.jl](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/MicrophysicsNonEq.jl). When `mp` and `opt` match, the check folds away at compile time; when mismatched, it throws a descriptive `ArgumentError`.

3. **Parameters Documentation**:
   - Adds documentation on Parameters Interface 
   - Auto-generates `docs/src/generated/ParametersReference.md` during the docs build from `parameter_groups()` and `name_map`, with tables of `ClimaParams` names, default values, units, and descriptions alongside collapsible struct docstrings
title: Check for parameter and options consistency, add parameters docs
